verdict.rationale: The Transaction Data Services return transaction data for accounts linked via Connect. The data refreshes daily, can be refreshed on demand through Data Refresh endpoints, and webhooks plus transaction notifications cover part of the change-tracking need. The evidence shows no pagination, no stated history depth, and no explicit delta or incremental sync pattern. Missing for 10: documented pagination, documented history depth (e.g. days or months of history), an explicit fetch-only-changes or cursor-based sync mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
